verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 resolves the remaining major finding. W1 now carries the admission-time epoch rather than re-reading it at write time, and every bind or retraction advances that epoch. The specified same-head ABA race (`none → head → none`) therefore makes the older W1 stale even though the live head and immutable verdict still name the same SHA; the older bind aborts and the retraction remains byte-identical. The record also requires both race orders and non-vacuous same-head/ABA assertions. The broader design remains fail-closed: absent state is UNKNOWN, disarm readers act while admission readers defer, authority changes at one sealed-census-gated resolver boundary, and mutable writes use semantic preconditions in addition to blob CAS. This documentation-only change is correct and complete for the requested design record.
